title: Gate28-NC1: frozen prequential null-mixture calibration falsification
scope: Contributor synthetic diagnostics only. No primary first-use, no native promotion, no accepted main/controller/owner runner mutation.
research_question: Can a public-only rolling prequential likelihood ratio to the fixed 0.5 consequence null suppress unwarranted causal confidence in independent noise without damaging structured-world held predictions, under identical observations and computation/memory ceilings?

hypotheses.H1_noise: On 900131-900133 noise, R held forced-action Brier of null-mixture <= .270 and improves mean R Brier vs fully fitted dense causal reward.
hypotheses.H2_structured: On fresh shifted 900111-900113 and stationary 900121-900123, average forced-action B/R held Brier of null-mixture no more than +.015 above dense conventional on each cohort.
hypotheses.H3_action: At identical forced exposure, chosen held actions and consequent held reward equal original dense reward, since calibration mixture action ranking is monotone in the uncalibrated prediction.
hypotheses.H4_resources: All per-intervention action/update work <= 8192 primitive rules, checkpoint <= 16384 bytes; source function cold snapshot and model checksum intact.

frozen_candidate_design.base_model: dense_causal_reward: 4888 uniformly stratified, fully fitted selected hypotheses (not complete grammar/exact Bayes)
frozen_candidate_design.update: For each eligible public consequence BEFORE observing that row: q=unmixed dense forecast from pre-update model; ell=ln(2*q) when y=1 else ln(2*(1-q)); append rounded 9-decimal ell to rolling last 32 observed public outcomes; never use held/query outcomes
frozen_candidate_design.gate: w = sigmoid(sum(last up to 32 ell) - ln(2)), with w=1/(1+exp(-clipped_logit)) for stable arithmetic. Original model fixed; no hidden phase labels.
frozen_candidate_design.predictive: p = 0.5 + w*(q-0.5). No phase oracle, no held-out fitting, no null labels
frozen_candidate_design.action_policy: Preserve original dense_causal_reward argmax q among 13 interventions; null gate cannot alter action ranking
frozen_candidate_design.source_retention: Seal frozen A96 snapshot of original full source predictive subset + null log ratios. Require checkpoint integrity, true cross-process cold restore, no held feedback
frozen_candidate_design.updates: A96 B64 R64 public actions; exact same 13 actions and observations as existing constrained controls under forced path
frozen_candidate_design.benchmark: R/B forced held Brier and chosen held reward; independent baseline full grammar remains over budget secondary only
frozen_candidate_design.evaluator: 9 fresh synthetic diagnostic worlds, 32 held queries per phase, no primary or external first-use

classification: Diagnostics only. Even all thresholds passing is ENGINEERING+DIAGNOSTIC_CANDIDATE, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS, no first-use or promotion. Report all cohort/seed negatives without tuning or hiding failures. Strongest trained full-grammar matched comparator still unqualified.
forbidden: Do not score reserved primary seeds; do not tune hyperparameters after seeing this cohort's scores; do not treat 9 diagnostic seeds as sufficient for independent scientific reproduction.
